default_stack.state_authority: SQLiteVersionedRepository + SQLiteAppendOnlyLedger (LOCAL host) or GitHub JSON observed-HEAD CAS (CHATGPT_GITHUB host)
default_stack.continuity_runtime: SQLiteCheckpointRuntime locally; UAOS state/task/action records in ChatGPT/GitHub host
default_stack.artifacts: LocalContentAddressedStore or exact domain/external artifacts registered through UAOS
default_stack.agent_provider: zero-cost-first host capability registry with circuit breaking/fallback
default_stack.portable_recovery: SQLite backup snapshot + artifact hash manifest for LOCAL host; Git history/CAS for CHATGPT_GITHUB controller state

phase18_resilience_tests.scope: circuit/fallback, wait/degrade states, portable snapshot integrity, opportunistic maintenance, risk-tier self-change

phase19_cross_repo_cutover.scope: old controller retirement, four Agent adapters/manifests/Skill entries, legacy task migration dispositions

known_limitations: semantic generation/research quality depends on host capabilities actually available in the active session
without an always-on free host, between-session work cannot execute continuously; due maintenance runs opportunistically on the next invocation
SQLite/local files are a single-machine LOCAL baseline; ChatGPT/GitHub host uses repository CAS rather than live multi-writer SQLite sync
high-impact external self-modification remains explicitly approval/policy gated
an unavailable capability with no safe fallback leaves only the affected work waiting rather than fabricating a result
legacy unfinished task business data remains in its domain repository until first explicit UAOS continuation/import; this is intentional lazy migration, not a second active controller
optional_enhancement_evidence: DBOS transparent crash replay and durable scheduling
